THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROFILE

PROFESSIONAL BIO

I'm Vexin, a Discord Administrator and Server Specialist with 6+ years on Discord. My experience includes building and rebuilding around 50 servers, designing role and permission systems, establishing moderation procedures, coordinating staff, improving community operations, and developing custom bots for server building, tickets, auto-roles, moderation, and AI-assisted features. I focus on practical systems, clear organization, fair moderation, and safer communities.

FULL BIO · ABOUT ME

I'm Vexin, known online as @vexin_vex. I've spent 6+ years learning and working with Discord communities, with experience across administration, server architecture, moderation leadership, community management, and custom bot development. I've built or reworked around 50 servers and regularly help others with server systems, roles, permissions, moderation tools, ticket workflows, onboarding, and troubleshooting. I have also built personal custom bots, including server-template builders, ticket bots, auto-role tools, moderation bots, and AI bots. I enjoy solving practical problems, creating clean systems, and keeping moderation fair and consistent. Outside Discord, I'm interested in anime, gaming, technology, art, programming, VFX, and video editing. I'm always learning and improving my work.
